decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension of the floor-care range, the cleaning soap supports aftersales customer retention and fits the firm's full-system wood flooring offer.
The maintenance oil complements installed wooden floors and reinforces recurring care-product sales, so a growing and innovative flooring firm would usually retain it.
This care product for oiled floors strengthens the maintenance ecosystem around the firm's core flooring products, with no clear sign that it should be withdrawn quickly.
A moisture-protection underlay is a practical accessory tied directly to floor installation and helps the firm sell complete flooring solutions to trade and project customers.
Although underlay foam is somewhat more standardised and could face margin pressure, it still fits the established flooring system range and is more likely to be kept than dropped.
An oak parquet floor is very close to the firm's core business and strategic strengths in wood processing, making continuation the most likely management choice.
